name: Japan Data Science Consortium Co.Ltd.
summary: Japan Data Science Consortium Co.Ltd. was established in 2013 and is headquartered in Tokyo. It creates and licenses machine-learning algorithm modules for the Japanese market. Its solutions include Wodom!, a data platform that maintains data quality, Sales Insight for sales digitalization through video distribution and tracking, and Response Insight, an AI tool that raises sales by cutting needless mailings.
